info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Submission API
info.description: The Loan Application Submission API facilitates the submission of loan applications for processing. This endpoint allows users to submit detailed information regarding their loan requests, ensuring that all necessary data is captured for evaluation. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and loan processing systems looking to streamline their application workflows. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their efficiency in handling loan applications and improve the overall customer experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a loan application for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all required information is provided in the request to process the application successfully.
